verdicts.reason: A: the dark header is now a dead block in the top-left with the logo shrunk to an unreadable speck, the orange divider floats alone, the body copy and 'Ships late June' are bigger than the tiny 'Reserve a Case' button, and the legal text is crammed into the bottom-right corner, so the brand is effectively lost and the hierarchy is inverted. B: the logo is far too large and competes with the headline, the dark bar is a stray fragment at the top right, the divider floats, the body copy is squeezed into a narrow ragged column placed above the CTA but away from the headline, and 'Ships late June' wraps awkwardly next to illegible legal text. Still, B keeps the brand mark intact and the headline dominant, so it is the less bad resize.
